verdict.rationale: Buzz documents a public wire protocol: third-party Nostr clients connect directly to buzz-relay over NIP-29/NIP-42, with a feature-status table. It also documents a signed-event-authenticated /api/admin/v1 HTTP API that the relay advertises for discovery. However, probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and the protocol's documented coverage is described via a feature-status table rather than a complete API reference. Missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), a full reference for the REST surface mentioned in the Helm docs, documented parity across all product features (repos, workflows, canvases), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Third-party Nostr clients connect directly to `buzz-relay` using NIP-29 and NIP-42 authentication.
Every /api/admin/v1 request must carry a NIP-98 HTTP Auth header containing a signed kind-27235 event.
a single relay binary serving WebSocket + REST + web UI
